		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_expected_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m161_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m161_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2161 days = 180 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2161 days = 30 } }
	}

zg361_pp_m162_core_effect = {
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_route value = $ROUTE$ }

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 }
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$

				EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m162_receipt_active = 0
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate = this

				OR = {
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 1
					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 2
				}
			}
			trigger_else_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_active = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_status = 1
				var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate = this
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_owner = var:zg361_case_u_owner
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_cycle = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				var:zg361_pp_m157_receipt_case = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial

					var:zg361_pp_m157_nomination_slot_status = 2
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available >= 1
				var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_available >= 1
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
				always = yes
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
			always = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
			zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_u_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_u_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_u_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_route
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = scope:zg361_pp_route
			OPERATION_ID = 162
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Route C is a policy-debt receipt, not a disguised business mutation.  It
			# deliberately does not call record_operation and therefore cannot change
			# the case revision, last operation, resource ledger, or typed payload.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_case_kernel_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m162_operation_capacity_status = 2

						var:zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception_slot_status = 2
					}

					always = yes
					always = yes
				}

				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

				}

zg361_pp_m162_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m162_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m162_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m162_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m162_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m162_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m162_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m162_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m162_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m162_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m162_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m162_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m162_tenure_exception } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_tenure_exception_slot_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}
